transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hello. Nice to meet you too. I came in because... well, it's my husband’s sister. She’s been working this family business situation just so she can get control of the money and push me right out of any decisions. 

People keep trying to smooth it over and act like everything is fine, but I know what I’ve been seeing. It's been going on for more than a year now, and I just know exactly what she's doing.
Has anyone else actually seen clear proof that your sister-in-law is trying to take control of the money?

Well, like I just said, folks mostly just try to smooth it over. They don't want to look at it too close or make a fuss. But I know what I’ve been seeing for more than a year now. 

She is working this family business specifically to get control of the money and push me right out of any decisions. The rest of them might not want to admit it's proof, but it's clear as day to me.
Have you heard voices when no one else was there?
No, I haven't heard any voices or anything like that. I'm just talking about what I see her doing with the business right in front of me.
Have you recently had a period where you felt unusually energetic and needed much less sleep than usual?
No, nothing like that. I sleep just fine, same as always. I'm not running around with extra energy or anything, I'm just trying to deal with this situation with my sister-in-law.
Have you generally found it hard to trust other people, even before this problem with your sister-in-law?

No, not really. I mean, I've always been pretty normal about that kind of thing. I trust people just fine until they give me a reason not to, you know? It's just her. This isn't about me not trusting folks in general, it's just what she's doing right now that's the problem.
Have you ever felt that someone was putting thoughts into your mind or taking thoughts out of your mind?
No, I've never felt anything like that. My thoughts are my own. I don't really know how somebody could even do that, to be honest. It's just normal thoughts in my head, nothing strange like that.
Aside from your sister-in-law, do you believe anyone else is trying to harm you or plot against you?

No, not at all. It's really just her. I don't have any problems with anyone else, and I don't think anyone else is out to get me or anything. Like I said, I'm just a regular person trying to live my life, it's just this one specific situation that's going on.
Has this situation caused major problems in your day-to-day functioning, like at work or in managing things at home?

Well, not major problems, no. I mean, I don't work, so that's not an issue. I guess... I have skipped some family get-togethers lately. And I definitely keep certain plans or, you know, money matters to myself now, just because I don't want any of that getting back to my husband's sister. 

But outside of having to do that? No. I still manage my usual routines around the house just fine, and I keep up with my church activities like I always have. It's really just being careful around her.
Have you noticed yourself becoming less emotionally expressive than you used to be?

No, I wouldn't say that. I still feel things the same way I always have. I mean, I laugh when something's funny, and I get upset if something's sad or frustrating... like with my sister-in-law. But no, I haven't noticed any change in how I show my emotions. I'm just the same as I've always been.
Have you ever smelled, felt, or seen anything that you believed was connected to what your sister-in-law is doing, when other people could not notice it?

No, I haven't. I don't see or smell anything strange, or feel anything like that. It's just... I just know what she's up to based on how she acts and the things she does. But no, I'm not seeing things that aren't there, if that's what you mean.
Did this belief about your sister-in-law begin very suddenly?

No, it wasn't sudden at all. It just sort of built up over time. I started noticing little things she would do, or the way she would look at me, and... well, eventually it just became clear what she was doing. But it didn't just happen overnight.
Have you ever felt that ordinary events or comments were meant specifically for you?

No, I don't think so. I mean, if you're talking about random things happening or... I don't know, people on the TV or strangers on the street, no. I don't think ordinary things like that are about me. 

It's really just my sister-in-law and the specific things she does that I pay attention to, because I know what she's up to. But regular, everyday stuff? No, I don't read into any of that. Regular stuff is just regular stuff.
Has anyone told you that your speech is hard to follow or that you jump from one idea to another?

No, nobody has ever said anything like that to me. I think I speak pretty clearly. I mean, I know what I want to say and I just say it. I don't get confused or jump around when I'm talking. People understand me just fine.
Have you ever felt that an outside force was controlling your actions or movements?

No, never. I mean, I'm the one in control of what I do. It's just me. Nobody else is making me move or do anything I don't want to do. That sounds... well, that sounds crazy to be honest. I just do what I do, same as anyone else.
Have you ever believed that strangers were talking about you or watching you?

No, I haven't. Strangers don't care about what I'm doing. They're just out running their own errands or going about their day. 

I don't pay any mind to people I don't know, and they don't pay any mind to me. Like I was saying before, it's really just my sister-in-law that I have to watch out for. I don't worry about random people on the street watching me.
Have you found yourself having much less motivation to do everyday things than you used to?

No, I wouldn't say that. I still get up and do what needs to be done around the house. I mean, I cook, I clean, I take care of my own business. I haven't noticed any change in my motivation or anything like that. I just keep up with my normal routine.
Has your sister-in-law ever done anything that seemed impossible or beyond ordinary means to control the money or influence your decisions?

No, nothing impossible. I mean, she's not using magic or anything crazy like that. She's just... she's just very sneaky and manipulative. 

She goes behind my back, talks to the rest of the family, maybe tells lies to get her way with the estate. It's all just normal, deceitful stuff she does to try and get her hands on what's mine. Nothing beyond ordinary means, she's just a liar who knows how to work the system.
Before all this with your sister-in-law, were you otherwise functioning normally in your daily life?

Oh, yes. I was, and I still am. I mean, I still keep up with my quilting group, and my choir practice... I go to my GED lessons and do my senior walks just like I always have. 

This whole situation hasn't stopped me from living my life. Mostly, it's just changed how much I trust my husband's sister, and, you know, which family gatherings I actually feel comfortable going to these days. But my day-to-day routine is exactly the same.
